channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Russian strikes kill 10 as Zelensky says Ukraine hits oil tankers and terminal
item.description: Russian strikes in Ukraine killed 10 people, according to reports. Zelensky said Ukraine's drones hit Russian oil tankers and a terminal, but the extent of the damage is unclear. Fatalities have been reported around Ukraine as Kyiv says Russian "shadow fleet" tankers were hit by drones.

item.title: Iran says U.S. military operation ‘impossible’ as Trump mulls peace proposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump faces a choice between a military operation deemed impossible by Iran's intelligence organisation and a peace proposal, according to a state television post. The Islamic Republic of Iran has presented a proposal to Trump, who must decide on a course of action.

item.title: US to cut troops in Germany as Iran war spat deepens
item.description: The US plans to cut troops in Germany amid a deepening spat between President Trump and Chancellor Merz over the war on Iran. The move strains US-German relations, with tensions escalating between the two nations.

item.title: Trump says he is likely to reject peace proposal as Iran has 'not yet paid a big enough price'
item.description: US President Donald Trump has expressed doubts about an Iranian peace proposal, saying Iran has not yet paid a big enough price. Trump's comments suggest he may reject the proposal, which has been presented by the Iranian government.

item.title: Iran presses for end to war within 30 days even as Trump expresses doubts
item.description: Iran's military has given the US 30 days to end the war, presenting two options: a military operation deemed impossible or a bad deal. The ultimatum comes as tensions between the two nations continue to escalate.

item.title: Tallest for nearly 25 years, now ranked 25th
item.description: The Sears Tower, completed in 1973, held the title of world's tallest building for nearly 25 years before being surpassed. Now ranked 25th, the tower remains a notable landmark in Chicago, with its height still a subject of urban legend.

item.title: Israel approves purchase of fighter jets from the US
item.description: Israel approved a purchase of F-35 and F-15IA fighter jets from Lockheed Martin and Boeing. Purchase includes two new combat squadrons of F-35 and F-15IA aircraft from Lockheed Martin and Boeing.

item.title: Two US service members missing after military exercises in Morocco
item.description: Two US service members are missing in Morocco after military exercises near Tan Tan.

item.title: Trump says Iran has not yet ‘paid a big enough price’ as he reviews new peace plan
item.description: Trump reviewed a new peace plan and said Iran has not paid a big enough price. Trump says Iran has not yet ‘paid a big enough price’ as he reviews new peace plan.

item.title: 'Impossible Operation Or Bad Deal': Iran Guards' 2 Options For Trump
item.description: Iran has kept the Strait of Hormuz largely closed after US actions. Iran has kept the key Strait of Hormuz largely closed. 'Impossible Operation Or Bad Deal': Iran Guards' 2 Options For Trump.

item.title: Between a fatwa and war: how Iran makes sense of its nuclear capability
item.description: Iran has vowed to protect its nuclear stockpile despite Trump's threats. The country's former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei previously disapproved of using nuclear weapons on religious grounds. Iran has ‘vowed’ to protect its nuclear stockpile against Trump’s threats even as its former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei disapproved of using nuclear weapons on religious grounds.

item.title: Taiwan President defiant as he begins Eswatini trip; China calls him a 'rat'
item.description: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te began a trip to Eswatini despite China's criticism. Lai Ching-te’s despicable conduct. ​like a rat scurrying across the street. will inevitably be met with ridicule by the international community, says China’s Taiwan ‌Affairs Office spokesperson.

item.title: Sleepless in Tehran as crowds rally behind the flag
item.description: Crowds in Tehran rallied behind the flag with slogans addressing the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. A slogan on a wall nearby in Farsi read, “Meydan bashuma, khayabane ba ma”. ‘The battlefield is yours.

item.title: The U.S. Set Off a Corruption Scandal That Is Gripping Mexico
item.description: A US indictment of a Mexican governor spotlighted cartel corruption in Mexico. The U. S. indictment of a Mexican governor has spotlighted cartel corruption, strained cross-border relations and handed President Claudia Sheinbaum a thorny choice.

item.title: Global Demand for Rare Earth Minerals Is Intensifying Criminal Threats in the Amazon Rainforest
item.description: Global demand for rare earth minerals is driving criminal activity in the Amazon Rainforest, fueled by surging demand for critical minerals used in drones and electric cars. Global demand for critical minerals, used to build drones and electric cars, is surging, setting of a new wave of criminality in the world’s largest rainforest.

item.title: Germany troop cuts send wrong signal to Russia, say two top US Republicans
item.description: Two top US Republicans say Germany's plan to cut 5,000 troops sends the wrong signal to Russia, risking deterrence. The chairs of the House and Senate armed services committees said withdrawing 5,000 service personnel risked undermining deterrence.

item.title: Diljit Dosanjh Asks Pro-Khalistanis Waving Flag At Canada Concert To Leave
item.description: Diljit Dosanjh asked pro-Khalistan supporters to leave his concert in Calgary, Canada, after they waved a flag. Singer Diljit Dosanjh at the concert in Canada's Calgary. Diljit Dosanjh Asks Pro-Khalistanis Waving Flag At Canada Concert To Leave.

item.title: Lived In US For 35 Years And 6 Weeks In ICE Custody, Indian Woman Released
item.description: Meenu Batra, an Indian woman, was released after 6 weeks in ICE custody, holding a withholding of removal status after 35 years in the US. Meenu Batra holds a "withholding of removal" status.

item.title: China’s security model blends tech, community, and digital growth
item.description: China's security model combines technology, community, and digital growth, according to Modern Diplomacy. China’s security model blends tech, community, and digital growth Modern Diplomacy.

item.title: US Carriers Offer 'Rescue Fares' To Fliers As Spirit Airlines Winds Down
item.description: US carriers are offering rescue fares to Spirit Airlines passengers as the airline winds down, following bankruptcy and potential bailout talks. Spirit Airlines has been in and out of bankruptcy since 2024, and the White House was recently considering a bailout.
